source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of the Sun

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Every section of the chapter ends with a warning when the sub-period lord rules the 2nd or 7th (maraka) and a remedial ritual; both are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy, as are named diseases.

variants.text: Sun-Sun: with the Sun exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle, trine or the 11th, a period of gains in money and provisions.
Sun-Sun: with the Sun debilitated or in an unfriendly sign, the gains are reversed into losses.

rules.text: Sun-Moon: with the Moon in an angle or trine, marriage or other auspicious functions, a good name through prosperity, growth in land and property, and vehicles and other assets.

variants.text: The Moon is dignified: affection in relationships, gains of money, the birth of a child, recognition from authority and the satisfaction of reaching one's goals.
The Moon also rules the 2nd and is well placed: substantial gains and lasting assets that later benefit the children.

rules.text: Sun-Moon: with the Moon weak and with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th — strain on spouse and children, friction with the community, a setback at work, displeasure of authority and financial loss; loss of confidence, change of place, disputes and litigation; take care around water.

Sun-Moon: benefics stand in an angle, the 8th or the 11th from the Sun — comforts, a rise in fortune, contentment, gains from authority, additional land, marriage if unmarried, festivities, ornaments, a vehicle, and the birth of a child or grandchild.
Sun-Moon: a weak Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Sun — poor diet and comforts, and much moving from place to place.
Sun-Mars: with Mars exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle, trine or the 11th — auspicious undertakings, purchase of a house, growing wealth, and acquisition of agricultural land.

variants.text: Mars in the ascendant: comforts and respect from the state.
Mars with the 9th or 11th lord: gains of money, a commanding position, victory over rivals, courage, and help from friends and siblings.

rules.text: Sun-Mars: Mars in the 8th or 12th from the Sun under malefic influence — loss of authority, dark thoughts and mental strain, confinement or restriction, enmity among siblings and failed ventures.
Sun-Mars: with Mars debilitated, loss of money through government action.
Sun-Rahu: with Rahu in an angle or trine, the first two months bring financial loss, anxiety and worry about theft or injury, and strain on spouse and child; after that the results turn good.

variants.text: Rahu is with a benefic: sound health, peace of mind and the goodwill of those in authority.

rules.text: Sun-Rahu: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, or well placed from the Sun — recognition from government, a rise in fortune and fame, a birth and festivities at home, though spouse and children go through some difficulty.
Sun-Rahu: Rahu in the 8th or 12th from the Sun — confinement or restriction, transfer, theft, risk of injury, and damage to house, land or livestock, though family life remains a comfort.

Sun-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle or trine or dignified — marriage if unmarried, meetings with senior authority, gains of money and provisions, the birth of a child, wishes fulfilled through official favour, and the affection of learned people.

variants.text: Jupiter rules the 9th or 10th: high position, costly vehicles, property and abundant happiness.
Jupiter is well placed from the Sun: a rise in fortune, good deeds, devotion to teacher and deity, and contentment.

rules.text: Sun-Jupiter: Jupiter in the 6th or 8th from the Sun, debilitated or with malefics — strain on spouse and children, health needing care, fear and mental distress, pressure from the authorities, and loss of something or someone valued.
Sun-Saturn: with Saturn in an angle or trine — rivals overcome, happiness, modest gains of money and provisions, and a wedding or other auspicious function at home.

variants.text: Saturn exalted or in its own sign: welfare at home, growth of assets, official recognition and wider prominence.

rules.text: Sun-Saturn: Saturn in the 6th or 12th from the Sun with malefics — health needs care, efforts fail, money is lost, and there is fear, restriction and litigation.
Sun-Saturn: with Saturn debilitated — falling out with friends at the start, a little comfort in the middle and conflict at the end, with worry over parents and a good deal of travel.

Sun-Mercury: with Mercury exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle or trine — benefits and favour from the state, high enthusiasm, happiness from spouse and children, a vehicle, ornaments and clothes, pilgrimage, and a comfortable, well-provided home.

variants.text: Mercury with the 9th or 11th lord: profits increase.
Mercury in the 5th, 9th or 10th: honours, good works and deepening religious thought, growing wealth, and the possibility of marriage or the birth of a child.

rules.text: Sun-Mercury: Mercury well placed from the Sun — abundant happiness, marriage, worship and charity, written commendation and a name made by some notable work, good food, clothes and ornaments.

Sun-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Sun or debilitated — health needs care, mental distress and strain on spouse and children. The start is the hardest part, the middle brings relief, and the end brings worry over authority and travel.
Sun-Ketu: in general a period of mental conflict, financial loss, displeasure of authority and clashes with friends; health needs care.

variants.text: Ketu is with the ascendant lord: some relief at the start, trouble in the middle.
Ketu is in the 8th or 12th from the Sun: change of place, loss of money and of a friendship, foreign travel, and trouble through opponents.

rules.text: Sun-Ketu: with Ketu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th — good fortune, happiness from spouse and children, new contacts with contented people, fine clothes and a growing reputation.

Sun-Venus: with Venus in an angle or trine or dignified — refined company, gains of goods and money, travel from place to place, meetings with learned and powerful people, enthusiasm, honours, well-being at home, fine food, gems and clothes, a costly vehicle, and growing fame and prosperity.

Sun-Venus: with Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th or weak — pressure from authority, mental conflict and financial loss, with strain around spouse or children. The start is middling, the middle brings gains and good events, and the end brings loss of reputation, displacement, coolness from friends and loss of comforts.
